contact.basis: Downstream center of the original Lands Department section in Hong Kong Principal Datum.

attribution: Lands Department, Hong Kong SAR Government
method: Unmodified source sample crop and bilinear interpolation to local meter coordinates. Original ArcInfo grid, transformed through Hong Kong 1980 Grid.
limitations: The published 5 m grid is approximate at a spillway this size and can contain some structures. It has no surveyed channel bathymetry.
